advice_items.quote: Real estate values never go down. They might recede in a recession, but they always correct above the line. Buy and hold.
advice_items.summary_en: Buy and hold real estate long-term because land is finite and values recover above trend after recessions.
advice_items.summary_zh: 长期买入并持有房地产，土地稀缺且长期必涨

advice_items.quote: Resiliency, grit, self-reliance, believing in yourself. Rainbows only follow storms. Can't have a rainbow without a storm first.
advice_items.summary_en: Young founders succeed through resilience, grit, self-reliance, and enduring storms before seeing success.
advice_items.summary_zh: 创业者须具备韧性与毅力，经历风雨方见彩虹

advice_items.quote: Stop BSing people. The more real somebody is, the more authenticity they're looking for... Really, the product is you. Be authentic.
advice_items.summary_en: In sales and negotiation, drop the games and be authentic so clients recognize your personal value.
advice_items.summary_zh: 销售谈判要真诚不作假，让自己成为核心价值

advice_items.quote: It's not about what you get, but what you have to give. And so, when you meet with somebody, say, 'What can I do for you?'
advice_items.summary_en: Wealthy people want genuine relationships, so lead by asking what you can do for them instead of taking.
advice_items.summary_zh: 高端人脉重在先问能为对方提供什么价值

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Surround Yourself With Toxic / Negative People
advice_items.quote: Surround yourself with givers, get the toxicity out of your life... If you hang around nine broke people, you'll be the tenth.
advice_items.summary_en: Remove toxic takers from your circle and surround yourself with givers, as proximity shapes your outcome.
advice_items.summary_zh: 远离消耗型人群，与付出者同行才能提升圈层

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: When I got my exit, when the wire came through, I was sitting at Taco Bell ordering a number three. Stay small enough long enough, you'll be big enough soon enough.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay grounded and stay lean long enough without chasing flashy spending even after a massive exit.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持谦逊简朴，长期稳扎稳打终会做大做强

guests.first_money_or_break: 20多岁积累百万美元流动资产，50岁完成超1亿美元的九位数公司退出套现。
guests.wealth_detail: $100M+ exit (nine-figure exit); millionaire in 20s, liquidity event at 50
guests.zero_start_advice: 把自己当成产品来投资，保持真实不虚伪，先思考能为他人提供什么价值并远离消耗型人群，同时长期持有房地产。

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: Founder, big problem, and a deep innovation... A big idea can move mountains, but you need big ideas consistently every day.
advice_items.summary_en: Winning ventures combine a strong founder, a big problem, deep innovation, and continuous daily creativity.
advice_items.summary_zh: 好项目需强创始人、大痛点、深创新与持续创意

advice_items.quote: Doing something you're really passionate about, working with people that you really love... focusing on a problem you would have wanted to solve whether you could make money at it or not.
advice_items.summary_en: Achieve alignment by working with people you love on problems you care about regardless of money.
advice_items.summary_zh: 与喜爱之人共事，解决不图钱也愿解决的问题

advice_items.quote: First you have to know yourself, then you have to love yourself, and then you have to be yourself.
advice_items.summary_en: Know, love, and be yourself instead of trying to imitate others just to fit in.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先认识自己、爱自己再做自己，不必迎合他人

guests.first_money_or_break: 约31岁成为百万富翁，创立MoviePass与智能牙刷品牌Fino并投资Ring等产品，单年最高收入约数百万美元。
guests.guest_name: Beverly Hills VC & MoviePass / Fino Founder
guests.wealth_detail: Millionaire at ~31; highest single-year income ~$2M (not a billionaire)
guests.zero_start_advice: 先认识自己、爱自己、做自己，选择与自己价值观契合且即便不赚钱也想解决的真问题，并与志同道合的人共事。

advice_items.quote: Learn to listen. Learn to be with the smartest people around... Surround myself with people that are way smarter than me.
advice_items.summary_en: Practice listening and deliberately surround yourself with people who are much smarter than you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 学会倾听，主动靠近并围绕比自己更聪明的人

advice_items.quote: Two things. Listen to your mom and dad and follow your favorite mentors. Jamie is one of my favorite mentors ever.
advice_items.summary_en: Listen to your parents and closely follow great mentors as a core key to success.
advice_items.summary_zh: 听取父母忠告并紧跟优秀导师学习，是成功秘诀

guests.first_money_or_break: 18岁成为百万富翁；后因在街头看到许多人穿猫王T恤而结识Authentic Brands Group的Jamie并向其学习商业品牌运作。
guests.role_or_title: NBA Hall of Famer, Businessman & Investor (Age 54)
guests.zero_start_advice: 学会倾听，靠近比自己更聪明的人，听取父母建议并向优秀导师学习。

advice_items.quote: Companies are broken, but, you know, brands, they have to have a heartbeat... that's the most important thing is when you're buying a brand that actually has a heartbeat and it's alive.
advice_items.summary_en: When acquiring distressed businesses, only buy brands that still have a strong cultural heartbeat and relevance.
advice_items.summary_zh: 收购品牌重在看其是否仍有鲜活的生命力与影响力

advice_items.quote: Do what you say you're going to do. Your word is your bond and make sure that you keep your word even if it costs you money.
advice_items.summary_en: Always keep your word as your bond and honor commitments even when doing so costs you money.
advice_items.summary_zh: 一诺千金，哪怕为此花钱也要坚决兑现自己的承诺

advice_items.quote: Money's just a scorecard. What's really important is to make sure you wake up every day, you have a great time doing what you're doing... always focus on happiness.
advice_items.summary_en: Treat money merely as a scorecard and prioritize enjoying what you do every single day.
advice_items.summary_zh: 金钱只是记分牌，最重要的是每天开心做喜欢的事

guests.first_money_or_break: 约36岁赚到第一个百万美元，深耕服装与品牌收购40年，旗下约50个品牌年营收达400亿美元。
guests.role_or_title: Authentic Brands Group Executive / Brand Owner (Age 63)
guests.wealth_detail: First million at ~36; company generates $40B/yr across ~50 brands
guests.zero_start_advice: 坚守信用、言出必行，哪怕亏钱也要守约；把金钱当记分牌，专注于每天做能带来快乐的事业。

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: You can never work for anybody else and get rich. You have to have your own desire, especially now with all the AI applications coming on. Work for yourself.
advice_items.summary_en: You cannot get rich working for someone else; leverage AI and build something for yourself.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打工无法真正致富，应善用AI机会为自己创业

advice_items.quote: The youth needs to learn the value of capital markets. Youth needs to learn that nothing is free... Somebody's got to pay for it.
advice_items.summary_en: Learn how capital markets work and recognize that nothing promised as 'free' is truly free.
advice_items.summary_zh: 年轻人要懂资本市场，明白世上没有真正的免费午餐

advice_items.quote: You have to be happy and find happiness in what you do. Share wealth. Enjoy the families. Enjoy the life.
advice_items.summary_en: Find joy in your work, share your wealth with others, and enjoy your family and life.
advice_items.summary_zh: 在事业中寻找快乐，乐于分享财富并珍惜陪伴家人

advice_items.quote: You have to stay young because mentally you have to be very strong, and you can't worry about little aches and pains. It's all here.
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain a youthful, resilient mindset and refuse to let minor setbacks or aches slow you down.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持年轻心态与强大意志力，别为小挫折内耗

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: Create something of value of society, don't ask for free... get your act together, don't blame the society, blame yourself.
advice_items.summary_en: Take personal accountability, stop blaming society, and create genuine value for the world.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别向社会索取也别怪环境，靠自身行动创造社会价值

guests.first_money_or_break: 从印度身无分文来到纽约，早期在华尔街机构交易数十亿美元资产，后自主创立Pre-IPO股权交易及硬资产借贷平台。
guests.role_or_title: Pre-IPO Shares Trader & Hard Money Lending Founder
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要指望打工致富或等待免费施舍，要理解资本市场并利用AI为自己创业，停止抱怨社会、通过创造社会价值改变命运。

advice_items.quote: They had no classes on how to be an investor. So, I started reading books... Most everything you need to know you can learn by reading.
advice_items.summary_en: Teach yourself investing and business fundamentals because nearly everything you need can be learned from books.
advice_items.summary_zh: 通过大量阅读自学成才，所需知识几乎都在书里

advice_items.quote: Persistence. Never giving up.
advice_items.summary_en: Persistence and refusing to give up through rejection is the common trait of top performers.
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持不懈、永不放弃是所有顶尖成功者的共性

advice_items.quote: Optimism... You have to be optimistic in order to be successful.
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain optimism and self-belief even when others doubt you or reject your ideas.
advice_items.summary_zh: 面对质疑和拒绝时保持乐观与坚定自信才能成功

advice_items.quote: What you know is more important. The ideas are more valuable than the relationships. Because if you have a great, creative, brilliant idea, the capital will find you.
advice_items.summary_en: Knowledge and brilliant ideas matter more than connections because great ideas naturally attract capital.
advice_items.summary_zh: 真才实学与绝妙创意胜过人脉，好点子自会吸引资本

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: Learn everything there is to know about AI. Start learning how to code using Claude code. Build a company. Build a website. Build something.
advice_items.summary_en: Master AI and coding tools like Claude Code now to build a business during this historic entrepreneurial wave.
advice_items.summary_zh: 全面学习AI并用Claude Code编程建站，抓住创业黄金期

advice_items.quote: Being able to be long-term in a world of short-term people, that's a huge advantage.
advice_items.summary_en: Adopt a multi-decade, long-term perspective in a world dominated by short-term thinkers.
advice_items.summary_zh: 在充满短视者的世界里坚持长期主义是巨大优势

advice_items.quote: Biggest challenge when you're young is you want to make money really fast. That's almost in investing a guaranteed bad outcome.
advice_items.summary_en: Trying to get rich quickly as a young investor almost guarantees poor investment outcomes.
advice_items.summary_zh: 年轻时切忌急功近利想赚快钱，投资中这几乎必败

guests.first_money_or_break: 想学投资却发现商学院没有相应课程，于是靠大量读书自学，并在早期不断打电话推销（smiling and dialing）与顶住拒绝中踏入投资管理行业。
guests.wealth_detail: $9B net worth (referred to as worth $9 billion by host)
guests.zero_start_advice: 靠大量阅读自学投资知识；立刻深入学习AI并用Claude Code等工具动手写代码创办项目；摒弃赚快钱心态，以数十年为周期坚持长期主义与永不放弃的乐观精神。
